niveau Bachelor duur 4 jaar locatie Alkmaar en Haarlem taal Nederlands

notes: The Bouwkunde programme page gives the study language as Dutch (taal Nederlands) and a duration of 4 years (duur 4 jaar). No tuition amount could be quoted for a non-EU student on this programme: the collegegeld page states institution-wide rates (instellingscollegegeld) but does not explicitly say they apply to this programme or to non-EU students, so tuition is left out. No language proficiency requirement for Dutch is stated on the Bouwkunde pages; the Creative Business page mentions B2 Dutch for students with foreign prior education, but that is another programme and is not evidence for this one.

note.fr: Vérifiez auprès de l'établissement si vous devez démontrer votre maîtrise du néerlandais et à quel niveau.
note.en: Check with the institution whether you need to demonstrate Dutch proficiency and at what level.
